[spoiler=Your Daily Nordiheimian News Flash]
The recognizable news room of 'Nordiheim News' comes up on the screen with the news anchor siting beind the glass desk, but instead of Jarli it is the female news anchor Asha that is sitting there for a change.
[i]Good day dear viewers and welcome to todays news flash and the many news we have for you today.[/i]
She says with a welcoming smile, before her demeanor shifts into a slightly more serious and proffesional one.

[i]Firstly the news from our hard working military men and women who are allways ready to defend our wonderfull nation.[/i]
The background screen starts showing a video of some type of energy weapon "burning" some drones and missiles out of the sky.
[i]The Ostland navy branch have joust finished its first of many live tests of the new 'Drake Fire' DEW defence system, the test reportedly went wonderfully being able to achive the full expected preformance much to the joy of the admiralty.
Experts we have talked with, and together from the few observation that was alloved of the test, tells us its a 'laser' type system that either "burns" or melts part of its target so that its function is disabled from continuing to work as intended.
Tough much more is not known about the system as it is still a rather classefied weapon, the experts also pointed out that the soonest we will acutaly see it installed on a navy ship, as part of its defence systems, will most likely not be before 2027 at the absolutely earlist since many more tests and trials would be needed, and then only on the newest vessels such as the Freki-Class Destroyers or the brand new Sleipnir-Class Frigates[/i]

The screen now changes to a picture of some type of fighter jet, it is not the best quality as airplane most likely went rather fast when the picture was taken.
[i]More sightings have also been made of the mysterious fighter jet around the area of the 'Red Wall mountain military research facility' indicating that the development of this airplane is going forward with good results, apparently its name is "Black Swan" according to an anonymous source wich would be a beatifull name for this seemingly elegant figther jet in my own opinion.[/i]
Asha says with joust a hint of a feminin smile

[i]As for news on the ecomony.[/i]
The screen now changes to economic graphs and stock market analytics as Asha one part of the papers on her desk tothe side.
[i]All information and statistics that can be had on the subject shows that the economy seems to be basicly ignoring the fact that the nation is generaly under heavy lockdown, most experts agree that this is only because of several positive factors happening at the same time.
The new trade deals that the nation have managed to achive despite the virus, the councils heavy focus on containing the spread of the virus and funding research into finding a cure or countermesure for it allowing the people to be hopefull and fealing relativly safe, the quick and efficient adaptation of 'online' options for both work, education and shopping of food and goods and ofcorse the many smart sulitions that have been done in the nations industry to be able to keep its production from falling behind market demand.
These among other small tings have not only prevented the internal economi from losing strenght but have also given the foreign markets reason to trust and see our economy as a good and stable option for purchases, sales and investments.
And experts are still confident that the economy is preped to joust become bigger when the virus is dealt with and the lockdown is ended[/i]

[i]And on the topic of the Lyondar virus.[/i]
The screen ones more changes what it shows, now being split in two, one side showing the symbol of Nordiheims department of health and the other a silent video showing a mix of worker with masks delivering medical containers to hospitals and doctors administering the new 'antibodies' injections.
[i]The first deliveries of the new 'Antibodies' injections have arived in hospitals in the Aboria and Ostland regions, and patients that have gotten them are said to have been showing quick improvements that promisses an increase of how many will survive the deadly virus.

A shipment of the 'antibodies' injection have allso been given to the small republic of Datia to help their mostly Aboriginal people together with a writhen promis that they will be given the same priorety as Nordiheimians regarding the creation of a vaccine, this comes from the fact that a recent national vote in Datia showed that 71% of the nation said they wanted to become a part of Nordiheim, spesificly the Aboria region, wich is a culumination of years of trade, friendship and diplomatic talks about becoming part of our nation[/i]
((The Republic of Datia is not a player nation, its a "npc" nation that is going to be part of my next expansion, joust to avoid confusion and I wanted to put some lore/fluff here for it))

[i]As for the potential vaccine the reports from the Sorlandian research labs are still promissing and bringing people great hope.[/i]
Asha discreetly slides some more papers to the side as the screen behind her changes to a video showing people being given shots in a hospital like place

[i]The officials at the main hospital that is doing the first tests of the newly made "prototype" vaccine says that a large amount of Nordiheimians from the tree regions of Midland, Vestland and Sorland have volunteered to test the vaccine wich allows them to do large scalle test at a fast rate, after health checks for safety reasons, leaving only the rate that they are able to make vaccines the most limiting factor.
Though the LV2B variant have tankfully shown itself easy to grow in cell cultures, wich researches says is a great boon for production speed over having to use the old egg metod, it have also not been to difficult to turn into a inactivated usable state.
Other then that the first prototype vaccine have been made using traditional ingredients for creation of Influenza vaccines.[/i]

With a good natured smile she adds.
[i]Hopefully the tests will show good results so propper production can be started and this lockdown ended quickly so we can all go out and enjoy the "baking Nordiheimian sun" ones more together with the drakes.[/i]

[i]That is all for this news flash, we hope you all have a wonderfull day and look forward to giving you the next news as they come, This have been Asha with the Nordiheim News Flash.[/i]
The news flash ends with its signature tune as the camera zooms out and shifts to the logo of the news channel before going to commershals.[/spoiler]
